faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.subtitle: Can't find an answer? Write to us — we're happy to help.
faq.a1: All technical specs of a space in one place: area, ceiling height, power capacity, shop window, hood, gas and more — so you know whether it fits your business before the viewing.
faq.q2: How up to date are the listings?
faq.a2: Every listing shows its last-confirmed date. Owners and brokers confirm with one click that the space is still available.
faq.a3: Describe what you need, e.g. “café in Vake, 80 m², up to 3,000 ₾”. We turn the text into filters you can adjust before searching.
faq.q4: How do I list a space?
faq.a4: Sign in with your phone number, upload photos, fill in the technical passport and set a price. You'll get a price recommendation based on the district average.
faq.a5: A CRM with a kanban board, a viewings calendar, an XML feed, a public profile with reviews and a client portal.
